reasons.plausibility: Al has very limited solubility in refractory BCC alloys and tends to form brittle intermetallics (e.g., M5Al3-type phases) with Hf, Ti, and Zr, making the assumption of a single-phase BCC solid solution with maintained strength highly questionable.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-defined, with specific compositions, processing, measurements, and quantitative rejection criteria (density reduction <5%, strength drop >10%, deleterious phases).
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses the core trade-off directly, but the choice of Al is scientifically problematic for this alloy system, which reduces its practical value for guiding experimental work.
